final: WITH per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS avg_alb, AVG(1.0 * l.UN / NULLIF(l.`T-BIL`, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), per_sex AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_patient GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS avg_alb FROM per_sex) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_alb - o.avg_alb FROM per_sex AS s JOIN overall AS o ON o.avg_alb IS NOT NULL WHERE s.avg_alb > o.avg_alb
